name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.70.0 — the fleet reader's ninth question, `owed`, lists every plugin-blaming row across this machine's checkouts (specs/20260903/01-owed-query-and-row-handoff.md): escape rows whose `preventedBy` is `review-check` or `runtime-leg`, missed replay rows, and unstamped `docs/spec-feedback/` findings, grouped by effective class with the joined recurrence count and a pointer to core § Incident Policy; fixed-status is derived from a citation scan over `specs/`, `spec/`, `tests/` in self-repair repos, never stored. `replay.js --record` gains `--via driver|manual` (stamped on the row and the artifact; `--stats` gains a `by-via` line); the review driver's REPLAY step and its `replay-recorded` refusal remedy both print `--via driver`. `escape-row.js --append` prints the derived row key on its confirmation line. Host doctrine: `escape.md` step 7 and `replay.md` Phase 5 report a plugin-blaming row's key with the sentence that the plugin repo's `fleet-reader --owed` consumes it — no handoff prompt is composed. tests/fleet-reader/owed.test.js, tests/fleet-reader/discovery.test.js, tests/replay/record-via.test.js, tests/review/review-driver.test.js, tests/escape/escape-row.test.js, tests/fleet-reader/doctrine-pins.test.js. 7.69.0 — page notes at two scopes, batch triage, author resolves (specs/20260902/10-page-notes-review-loop.md): `design-atlas.js serve` injects a notes layer (`?clean` strips it for capture) exposing add/list/resolve endpoints; every write goes through the new `spec/scripts/lib/mocks-notes.js`, writing `design/mocks/notes.json` (two scopes — a screen+state or the whole project, never an element). `mocks-driver.js` gains `notes open|address|reply` (no `resolve` subcommand — only the served page's Resolve button, by the author, can close a note); `journey-approved`, `journey-skinned`, `journey-reviewed`, and `approved` refuse while a project note or a screen's note is unresolved, naming it. `/spec:mocks` gains the REVIEW-state review loop (sitting → go → triage into `mock detail` / `product understanding` / `question back` / `propose to decline`, canon.md first) and the REVIEW sign-off literal (approval is on understanding — the written brief, not these screens, holds scope); `/spec:atlas` and `/spec:sketch` route their annotation loops through `design-atlas.js serve` + `notes open`, retiring the undiscoverable local-annotation-MCP discovery clause. spec/doctrine/mocks.md gains `## Mocks: Page Notes`. tests/mocks/mocks-notes.test.js, tests/design-atlas.test.js, tests/consistency/design-doctrine.test.js. 7.68.0 — one hand authors every mock and one token set backs every register (specs/20260902/09-one-hand-wireframes-one-token-set.md): design.md § Design Atlas's authorship paragraph is replaced — every mock, wireframe or themed, is authored and edited in-session by one hand, no `Agent` dispatch ever writes a mock at any stage or tier (subagents run judgment-free checks only), and grounding opens at the mocks seed/canon; `/spec:atlas` and `/spec:sketch` drop their sequential-Fable-dispatch/Sonnet-mechanical-edit split and cite the shared paragraph, printing `🎨 authored {N} in-session · {K} check-only dispatches`; core.md § Model Placement's parenthetical follows. mocks.md gains `## Mocks: Authoring Rules` (the six dry-run-converged wireframe/theme rules as contract prose). `spec/templates/mocks/viewer.css` ships shadcn's default zinc tokens and the full chrome register (`.v-card .v-btn .v-badge .v-input .v-bar .v-chip` + gallery/lightbox/matrix-toolbar rules on `--v-*` roles only); `wire-tokens.css` gains `--muted-bg` and is pinned value-equal to `viewer.css` per role; `wire.css` is re-based onto those roles with dashed `--border` placeholders, gray `--muted-bg` fills, no shadow, and no filled button but `.btn.primary` on `--muted-bg`. tests/mocks/viewer-tokens.test.js, tests/consistency/design-doctrine.test.js, tests/consistency/genesis-doctrine.test.js.
